name: zip-frames
description: ZipFrames — sistema de processamento de vídeos da FIAP X

scripts.infra:up: sh dev-keygen.sh && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.infra:apps: sh dev-keygen.sh && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose/docker-compose.yml --profile apps up -d --build
scripts.infra:reset: sh dev-keygen.sh && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose/docker-compose.yml --profile apps down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --dir services/auth-service db:seed && pnpm --dir services/video-service db:seed && pnpm --dir services/notifier-service db:seed
